visual_brief.subject: A coordinated 1.0 hardening release for seven MCP reference servers
verified_context: The Model Context Protocol project released seven reference servers together: four TypeScript packages at 1.0.0 and the fetch, Git, and time Python servers at 2026.10.10.

The filesystem release tightened roots synchronization, the memory server added serialized and cross-process file locking, and the fetch server now refuses private, loopback, and metadata addresses by default.
The release also added protocol-level characterization tests, per-file coverage gates, Windows CI, publishing controls, and a release audit.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A 1.0 label is earned by aligning several different tool modules behind one hardened set of boundaries and tests, while external enforcement still surrounds the system.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Seven distinct physical tool modules seated into a heavy shared protocol chassis, with one terracotta locking spine and an outer containment plinth showing that the modules are coordinated but not self-securing.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant. Seven recognizable tool-like modules form a strong silhouette, but globe, database, graph, and clock motifs make the piece more literal and iconographic than the golden references.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. Seven distinct sculptural modules sit in one heavy test bench and are held by a single terracotta calibration spine inside a larger architectural boundary; the metaphor remains legible without text or diagram language.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. Seven radial segments produce a clean shared-baseline metaphor and excellent negative space, but the repeated geometry communicates modular unity more strongly than release hardening or testing.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 1600 x 900 center crop preserves all seven modules, the shared dark chassis, the full terracotta locking spine, and the enclosing pale architecture.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow cover crop keeps the terracotta sphere, adjacent modules, and calibration spine as the dominant relationship while the chassis remains legible.
crop_review.thumbnail: At 320px wide, the seven high-contrast module silhouettes and one terracotta horizontal spine remain distinct without relying on surface detail.

golden_reference_comparison: Direct comparison with the API gateway and MCP secrets references shows the same warm paper ground, near-black architectural mass, sparing terracotta accent, physical depth, quiet landscape, and strong negative space. Candidate B has more modular objects than the references but preserves their sculptural editorial presence rather than becoming a schematic.
